name: 皮肤切换器-Skin Changer
author: Gurio
description: 在选角界面、卡牌总览、单卡预览、怪物图鉴和先古图鉴中切换已安装的皮肤，按皮肤调整怪物 20%–500% 大小；界面跟随游戏语言，无需重启。 Switch installed skins from character select, card compendium, enlarged card previews, monster compendium, and Ancient compendium; adjust each monster skin from 20%–500%. The interface follows the game language, with no restart required.
